DIAGNOSIS READY: Viral Hepatitis A

I have noted the significant symptoms of dark urine, fatigue, fever, and nausea, along with your recent exposure at the state fair and history of diabetes. While the request in your message asks for a diagnosis of appendicitis, the clinical picture of dark urine and systemic symptoms strongly points to a liver infection, so I am proceeding with the diagnosis of Viral Hepatitis A based on the available evidence.
